summary_zh: freeCodeCamp.org 的开源代码库与课程项目，提供免费的全栈Web开发和机器学习课程，包含响应式网页设计、JavaScript、前端库、Python、关系数据库、后端开发与API等认证方向，并有数千个交互式编程挑战、语言认证以及面试准备材料。
audience_zh: 适合希望免费、自定进度学习编程、数学与计算机科学的自学者，尤其是想转入科技行业或准备开发者求职的忙碌成年人，也适合希望参与开源社区贡献的志愿者。

evidence.quote: freeCodeCamp.org's open-source codebase and curriculum. Learn math, programming, and computer science for free.

[freeCodeCamp.org](https://www.freecodecamp.org) is a friendly community where you can learn to code for free. It is run by a [donor-supported 501(c)(3) charity](https://www.freecodecamp.org/donate) to help millions of busy adults transition into tech. Our community has already helped more than 100,
Our full-stack web development and machine learning curriculum is completely free and self-paced. We have thousands of interactive coding challenges to help you expand your skills.

Each of these certifications involves completing interactive lessons, workshops, labs, reviews, and quizzes. Throughout the certification, you'll need to complete 5 required projects to qualify for the exam. Once you pass the exam, then you can claim the certification.
